effect_description_eng:
＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
＜Decode ([Aegiomon])＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 [Aegiomon] from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.)
[When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -5000 DP for the turn. Then, if you have 3 or fewer security cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 7000 DP or less.
